steps.name: Check and raise minimum requirement versions
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import urllib.request

manifest_path = "custom_components/ble_esl/manifest.json"
packages = ["imagespec", "blesession"]

def version_tuple(version):
    parts = [int(part) for part in version.split(".")]
    while len(parts) > 1 and parts[-1] == 0:
        parts.pop()  # 1.0 and 1.0.0 are the same release
    return tuple(parts)

with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()
json.loads(text)  # fail early on a broken manifest

updates = []
for package in packages:
    # "imagespec[datamatrix]>=1.0.0" or the older "imagespec==1.0.0"
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'"%s(\[[^\]]*\])?(==|>=)([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*)"' % re.escape(package)
    )
    match = pattern.search(text)
    if not match:
        if re.search(r'"%s[\[<>=~! ]' % re.escape(package), text):
            # Listed, but not as ==x.y.z or >=x.y.z: do not skip it silently.
            print(f"::error::{package} is in manifest.json in a form this bot does not understand")
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"No {package} requirement found in manifest.json")
        continue
    extras, operator, current = match.groups()
    extras = extras or ""

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://pypi.org/pypi/{package}/json") as response:
            latest = json.loads(response.read().decode())["info"]["version"]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to fetch {package} from PyPI: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*", latest):
        print(f"{package}: latest {latest} is not a plain release, skipping")
        continue

    print(f"{package}: current minimum {operator}{current}, latest {latest}")
    target = latest if version_tuple(latest) > version_tuple(current) else current
    if operator == "==" or target != current:
        text = text.replace(
            match.group(0), f'"{package}{extras}>={target}"'
        )
        updates.append((package, current, target, operator))

if not updates:
    print("Already up to date!")
    sys.exit(0)

# Raw text, so the manifest's formatting is preserved
with open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write(text)

raised = [(p, c, t) for p, c, t, o in updates if t != c]
normalized = [p for p, c, t, o in updates if t == c]
parts = [f"bump {p} to {t}" for p, c, t in raised]
parts += [f"use >= for {p}" for p in normalized]
title = "chore: " + " and ".join(parts)
# One branch, so a newer release updates the open PR instead of
# opening a second one that conflicts with it.
branch = "dep-bump-requirements"
lines = [f"- {p}: >={c} -> >={t}" for p, c, t in raised]
lines += [f"- {p}: ==x -> >=x (minimum-version requirement)" for p in normalized]
body = (
    "Automated dependency update. The manifest requires a minimum version "
    "(`>=`):\n\n" + "\n".join(lines)
)
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a") as env_file:
    env_file.write("VERSION_UPDATED=true\n")
    env_file.write(f"BUMP_BRANCH={branch}\n")
    env_file.write(f"BUMP_TITLE={title}\n")
    env_file.write("BUMP_BODY<<EOF\n" + body + "\nEOF\n")
PY

steps.name: Check and update imagespec version
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import urllib.request
import re
import os
import sys
from packaging.version import Version

manifest_path = "custom_components/ble_led_sign/manifest.json"
with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    manifest = json.load(f)

# Find current imagespec version
current_req = None
current_version = None
for req in manifest.get("requirements", []):
    if req.startswith("imagespec"):
        current_req = req
        match = re.search(r"(==|>=)([0-9.]+)", req)
        if match:
            current_operator, current_version = match.groups()
        break

if not current_version:
    print("No imagespec requirement found in manifest.json")
    sys.exit(0)
    
# Fetch latest version from PyPI
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/imagespec/json") as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
        latest_version = data["info"]["version"]
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Failed to fetch from PyPI: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
    
print(f"Current version: {current_version}, Latest version: {latest_version}")

if current_operator == "==" or Version(latest_version) > Version(current_version):
    # Read raw text to preserve formatting and update the version
    with open(manifest_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()
    new_text = re.sub(
        r'"imagespec(\[[^\]]*\])?(?:==|>=)[0-9.]+"',
        lambda match: f'"imagespec{match.group(1) or ""}>={latest_version}"',
        text,
        count=1,
    )
    with open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(new_text)
    
    # Set output environment variable for next steps
    if 'GITHUB_ENV' in os.environ:
        with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as env_file:
            env_file.write("VERSION_UPDATED=true\n")
            env_file.write(f"LATEST_VERSION={latest_version}\n")
else:
    print("Minimum requirement is already current or newer.")
PY

steps.name: Create Pull Request
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

branch="${BUMP_BRANCH}"

git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

git checkout -B "${branch}"
git add custom_components/catprinter/manifest.json
git commit -m "${BUMP_TITLE}"
# The daily run recomputes the same bump; do not push an identical
# tree again (it would only re-trigger CI and rewrite the PR's history).
pushed=true
created=false
if git fetch --quiet origin "${branch}" 2>/dev/null \
  && git diff --quiet "origin/${branch}" HEAD; then
  echo "Branch ${branch} is already up to date"
  pushed=false
else
  git push --force origin "${branch}"
fi

existing_pr="$(gh pr list --head "${branch}" --base main --json number --jq '.[0].number' || true)"
if [ -n "$existing_pr" ] && [ "$existing_pr" != "null" ]; then
  echo "Pull request #${existing_pr} exists; updating its title and body"
  gh pr edit "${existing_pr}" --title "${BUMP_TITLE}" --body "${BUMP_BODY}"
elif ! gh pr create \
  --base main \
  --head "${branch}" \
  --title "${BUMP_TITLE}" \
  --body "${BUMP_BODY}"; then
  echo "::error::Failed to create pull request. In repository Settings > Actions > General, enable 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests'."
  echo "Branch was pushed. Open a PR manually: https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/compare/main...${branch}?expand=1"
  exit 1
else
  created=true
fi

# Events caused by GITHUB_TOKEN do not start other workflows, so the
# bump PR would carry no test results. Start them explicitly.
if [ "${pushed}" = "true" ] || [ "${created}" = "true" ]; then
  gh workflow run tests.yml --ref "${branch}" \
    || echo "::warning::Could not start the Tests workflow on ${branch}"
fi
